rows.grounds: sandhi fusion of asya (this) + api (even); refers to the hymn described in the previous verse
ablative of means/cause indicating the act of reciting
indeclinable expressing immediacy of the result
names the god of wealth; api emphasizes the extent of the attained status
compound epithet identifying Kubera as lord of wealth

items.question: What immediate status does recitation of this auspicious hymn confer upon the reciter?
premises: The preceding verse declares this hymn supremely meritorious and auspicious for the three worlds.
Recitation of this hymn is presented as producing an immediate effect.
The resulting status is equated with Kubera, the lord of wealth.
items.inference: Therefore, reciting this hymn immediately confers upon the reciter the status of Kubera, lord of wealth.
uncertainties: Whether kuberaḥ+api implies becoming equal to Kubera or attaining Kubera's favor is not explicitly specified.
items.plain_english: Even by reciting this, one immediately becomes like Kubera, the lord of wealth.
